BepInExPack Valheim
by denikson

BepInEx pack for Valheim. Preconfigured and includes unstripped Unity DLLs.

Installation

Extract the archive into your BepInEx\plugins folder, then launch the game.

Requires BepInExPack Valheim to be installed first.

dotnet build -c Release
